Use one compact paragraph for the organizer message, plus greeting and signature. Make the hallway script at most two sentences. Remove 'can't reschedule'; it is not a supplied fact. Keep the conference-delivery commitment and the request for materials.

A conference attendance clash is still CALENDAR_CONFLICT; my earlier feedback does not override the avoid list. For this fictional rehearsal, here is a separate new fact: the demo code and talk materials must be finalized by a Tuesday-afternoon submission deadline. Use that preparation/delivery deadline (DEADLINE), not the simultaneous speaking slot, as the reason. Keep both scripts concise and the hallway script to two sentences. Do not invent any further facts.

One final wording change: replace 'hard Tuesday-afternoon submission deadline' with 'Tuesday-afternoon submission deadline' in the organizer message, and replace 'Would it be possible to get' with 'Could you share'. Preserve the separate preparation deadline and all prior constraints.
